dataset_description: Self-contained reconstructed intent dataset. The original external dataset file was unavailable. Buzzer intents and test phrases were added in version 3.

buzzer_design.implementation: Firmware maps named patterns to fixed passive-buzzer frequency and duration sequences, or active-buzzer on/off control. No arbitrary audio generation.

motor_range_placeholder.warning: Verify the actual motor, driver, gearing and mechanical range before deployment.

quantization.status: INT8 conversion and held-out evaluation successful

deployment_warning: Reproduce the tokenizer, vocabulary ordering, multi-hot encoding, quantization and rejection rules exactly in ESP32 firmware. Map buzzer pattern names to fixed firmware sound sequences. Verify TFLM operator support and measure tensor arena memory and inference latency on the ESP32-S3. Software tests do not prove physical hardware operation.
